styles.label: Soft
styles.description: Warm, rounded tones with gentle edges for restrained feedback.

styles.label: Tactile
styles.description: Compact, muted percussive tones with a subtle physical tick.

styles.label: Playful
styles.description: Rounded plucks with a little brightness and a more expressive feel.

cues.label: Success
cues.meaning: A real action or validation succeeded.
cues.example: A submitted SQL answer is confirmed correct.

cues.label: Error
cues.meaning: A real submitted action failed or needs correction.
cues.example: A submitted SQL answer produces a confirmed validation error.

cues.label: Complete
cues.example: A chapter first becomes complete after progress is saved.

cues.label: Notification
cues.example: A requested task finishes and its visible notification becomes available.

userChoicePolicy.scope: Before integrating sound into a consuming app
userChoicePolicy.offBehavior: Do not add consuming-app sound integration.
userChoicePolicy.previewPermission: A preview audition does not enable sound for users of the consuming app.
userChoicePolicy.validationLimit: Plan validation checks recorded structure and does not prove human consent.

integrations.name: SoundsProvider
integrations.usage: Stable app boundary; starts disabled with volume 0.25.

integrations.name: useSounds
integrations.usage: Play a cue once from a real event handler and read the resolved sound state.

integrations.name: useSoundPlayer
integrations.usage: A stable play and stop for components that trigger cues but do not show sound state.

integrations.name: SoundControls
integrations.usage: Unstyled enable/disable, mute, volume, and stop controls, with data-sound-control hooks for styling and an onEnabled callback.

integrations.name: createSoundEngine
integrations.usage: A sound engine with the same explicit enablement and defaults.

constraints: Visible feedback must remain available without sound.
Enable live audio only from a trusted user interaction.
No autoplay, continuous loops, hover sounds, or typing sounds.
Only one cue may be active; stop and disable must cancel pending notes.
Sound preferences are independent of reduced-motion preferences.
Map cues to real events once; do not fake failures or replay cues on render.
